title: 第19章 曝光第20章 披着羊皮的狼
lines: 第19章曝光
而且在柏林她就知道他还有事情要处理，所以也不耽搁他。
“恩，你去吧！”
没了先前的顾虑，此刻的夏天跟权天睿相处起来，也是比较轻松的。
想着他对自己的温柔，处处为自己考虑，夏天的不禁被一种甜甜的东西给融入在了其中。
权天睿这一忙便是好几天，夏天自然也没有闲下，霸占了书房里另一个书桌。
这几日旅行去了，稿子一直拖着，这会儿回来了，自然是补上。
一开始画稿的夏天，基本上就是个工作狂人，整个世界都剩下她一个人似得。
权天睿工作狂可是出了名的，所以一连好几天，整个书房都是安静的只剩下敲键盘声，跟鼠标声。
相对于二人的安静，外面可是炸开了锅。
夏天跟权天睿回来的第二天，他们就上了娱乐版头条。
权氏集团权天睿抱着神秘女子现身机场。
各种醒目的标题，还附带着高清的照片。
权天睿一脸冷然，紧紧的拥护着怀中的神秘女子。
这对于从来没有任何桃-色绯闻的权天睿来说，爆出这样的新闻，那威力跟深水炸弹没有什么区别。
网上的言论更是讨论的热火朝天。
大多女网友表示，老公被人抢了。
更有人大胆说出，放开我老公，让我来。
心碎成了渣渣。
不管是哪一种，无一表现出了对权天睿怀里的那个女人的各种羡慕嫉妒。
只是更多人却在好奇，能被冷情的权天睿护在怀里，那个女人究竟是谁，长得何等模样。
当然最好奇的，要数权家在H市老宅里的这个女人。
“爸，这个女人是谁啊？”
权以蔷看着报纸上那硕大的照片，眼眸之中酝酿着狂风暴雨，恨不能直接冲过去撕了被自己哥哥怀中抱着的那个女人。
权详接过权以蔷递给自己的报纸，看到报纸上权天睿紧紧抱着一个人女人的画面之时，那平静无波的眼眸之中，多了些许的激动。
虽然看不到那女人的脸，但是他能抱着一个女人就足以证明那个女人的不简单。
他的这个儿子莫不是开窍了？
要说权详可是为这个儿子操碎了心，都快三十了，还没谈个女朋友，外界更是传言他是同性恋，身为他老爹，自然是操心他的婚事了。
劝说多次，无果，权详也是没有办法了。
他不可能舔着老脸硬塞一个女人上他床吧！
如今看到这新闻，简直是可喜可贺。
瞧着权详那激动的样子，权以蔷的心情更加不好了。
“爸，你说要是这女人家世不清白怎么办，而且会不会是因为我们家的钱才跟哥在一起的？”
权以蔷抿着嘴唇，若有其事的说道。
不管如何，她绝对不会让这样一个莫名其妙出现的女人成为她的嫂子。
权详放下手中的报纸，看向自己的女儿。
content_en:
Chapter 19 Exposure
And she knew that he still had things to deal with in Berlin, so she didn't delay him.
"Well, you go ahead!"
Without the previous worries, it was now relatively easy for Xia Tian to get along with Quan Tianrui.
Thinking of how gentle he was to her and how he always considered herself, Xia Tian couldn't help but feel something sweet mixed into it.
Quan Tianrui was busy for several days, and Xia Tian was naturally not idle either, occupying another desk in the study.
I have been traveling these past few days and have been putting off the manuscript. Now that I am back, I will naturally make up for it.
When Xia Tian started drawing, she was basically a workaholic, as if she was alone in the world.
Quan Tianrui is famous for being a workaholic, so for several days, the entire study was quiet except for the sound of typing on the keyboard and the sound of the mouse.
Compared to the silence between the two of them, there was an explosion outside.
The day after Xia Tian and Quan Tianrui came back, they made the headlines of the entertainment section.
Quan Tianrui of the Quan Group appeared at the airport holding a mysterious woman.
Various eye-catching titles are accompanied by high-definition photos.
Quan Tianrui had a cold expression on his face and tightly supported the mysterious woman in his arms.
For Quan Tianrui, who has never had any scandals, the power of breaking such news is no different from that of a depth bomb.
The discussion on the Internet is even more lively.
Most female netizens said that their husbands were robbed.
Some people even boldly said, let go of my husband and let me do it.
The heart was broken into pieces.
No matter which one they were, none of them showed any kind of envy and jealousy towards the woman in Quan Tianrui's arms.
But more people are curious about who the woman who can be protected by the cold-hearted Quan Tianrui is and what she looks like.
Of course, the most curious thing is the woman in the Quan family's old house in H City.
"Dad, who is this woman?"
Quan Yiqiang looked at the huge photo in the newspaper, a storm brewing in her eyes, wishing she could rush over and tear the woman in her brother's arms away.
Quan Xiang took the newspaper handed to him by Quan Yiqiang. When he saw the picture of Quan Tianrui hugging a woman tightly in the newspaper, there was a little excitement in his calm eyes.
Although he couldn't see the woman's face, the fact that he could hold a woman was enough to prove that the woman was not simple.
Could it be that his son has become enlightened?
To say that Quan is detailed, he is worried about his son. He is almost thirty and has not yet found a girlfriend. There are even rumors that he is gay. As his father, he is naturally worried about his marriage.
I tried to persuade him many times, but to no avail, and Quan Xiang had no choice.
There's no way he could lick his old face and force a woman into his bed!
Now that I see this news, it is really gratifying.
Seeing Quan Xiang's excited look, Quan Yiqiang's mood became even worse.
“Dad, what do you think we should do if this woman’s family background is not clean, and is she with my brother because of our family’s money?”
Quan Yiqiang pursed her lips and said calmly.
No matter what, she would never let such a woman who appeared out of nowhere become her sister-in-law.
Quan Xiang put down the newspaper in his hand and looked at his daughter.
